name: todoist
description: Manage Todoist tasks: create, complete, update, delete, and list.
skillSummary: Manage tasks in Todoist. Create, complete, update, delete, and list tasks. Supports due dates, priorities, and fuzzy name matching.

tools.name: todoist.list-tasks
tools.description: List tasks from Todoist. Can filter with a Todoist query like 'today', 'overdue', or 'p1'.

filter.description: Todoist filter query (e.g. 'today', 'overdue', 'p1'). Leave empty for all active tasks.

tools.name: todoist.add-task
tools.description: Create a new task in Todoist.

dueString.description: Due date in natural language (e.g. 'tomorrow', 'next monday', 'today')

tools.name: todoist.complete-task
tools.description: Mark a task as complete using fuzzy name matching.

taskName.description: Name or partial name of the task to complete

tools.name: todoist.update-task
tools.description: Update an existing task's content, description, due date, or priority.

taskName.description: Name or partial name of the task to update

dueString.description: New due date in natural language

tools.name: todoist.delete-task
tools.description: Permanently delete a task from Todoist. This cannot be undone.

taskName.description: Name or partial name of the task to delete

proactive.name: daily-tasks-briefing
proactive.description: Send today's task list every morning
